item.title: Jeers again as home woes continue - Jaissle has big problems at Newcastle

item.title: From nightmare debut season to Everton hero - Barry's revival
item.description: Last season Thierno Barry scored eight goals in 41 appearances. This season it's taken him just 12 games to match that tally.

item.title: Who produced the kind of performance Moyes loves? - player ratings

item.title: Carrick says it's 'crazy' but he's looking forward to Roma game

item.title: Fifa to share 'key documents' over World Cup sell-off plan
item.description: Council members will need to travel to Fifa's headquarters in Zurich to see the documents, and will be subject to "strict review protocols".

item.description: Everton manager David Moyes' post-match reaction to his side's one-goal win against struggling Newcastle United, as well as the availability of Jack Grealish following disciplinary action.

item.title: Jaissle unhappy with 'clear foul' before Barry goal

item.title: Arsenal move clear at the top with a rare win at Liverpool
